steps.content: You put on your armor and wave at Vanilla, who is working on the scaffold of the mech not far away.
Hearing this, she pauses her work for a moment and looks at you.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: Don't venture into dangerous areas just because I've upgraded your armor.

In order to find all the materials as soon as possible and take Vanilla out to solve the Illusory Moon crisis, exploring dangerous zones is inevitable. However, you simply nod at her without saying anything.
Fortunately, Vanilla doesn't delve too deep. She just smiles and waves goodbye.
